title: Valencia: Cathedral Light & Modern Curves
description: Valencia moves from the Cathedral’s quiet stone interior to the sweeping white architecture of the City of Arts and Sciences. This photo film lingers on ribbed vaults, a gilded altar, sculptural bridges, glass walls and reflecting pools in soft morning light. Eight owner-approved original photographs appear in their selected order, composed independently for portrait and widescreen viewing. The film invites viewers to discover the individual still photographs; the video itself is promotional and is not offered for sale. Music: ‘Dance of Andalusia - Flamenco Acoustic Guitar Instrumental’ by nickpanekAIassets via Pixabay.
